title: The private sheet works with the network off, and a workspace can leave as a portable bundle

goals.description: Mode switch — manual Work offline is authoritative; auto-detect may only degrade, never silently resync
Offline UI: group sheet read-only with lastSyncedAt; disabled affordances labelled, not hidden
"Back online · N changes to sync" with an explicit button
Export: document.pdf with /Highlight annotations appended (/NM = slug), notes.md with <!-- tb … --> anchors, thinkboard.json, zipped with fflate
Re-import: the HTML comment is the only identity anchor; anchorless sections import as new unanchored notes; orphans reported, never guessed
Clear local data on sign out — Dexie AND OPFS (F6); the group document is not cached offline by default
